title: stencil with polydata contour
explanation:
### Description

Test vtkPolyDataToImageStencil with a complex closed contour and spurs.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → interaction → output**

- [vtkCellArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellArray.html) — cell array.
- [vtkImageData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageData.html) — represents a regular grid of points (image/volume).
- [vtkImageSlice](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageSlice.html) — image slice.
- [vtkImageSliceMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageSliceMapper.html) — image slice mapper.
- [vtkImageStencil](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageStencil.html) — image stencil.
- [vtkInteractorStyleImage](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkInteractorStyleImage.html) — interactor style image.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyData.html) — represents polygonal geometry.
- [vtkPolyDataToImageStencil](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataToImageStencil.html) — poly data to image stencil.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
